# @trysac/cron-explain

> Parse Vixie cron expressions, explain them in plain English and compute next run times in IANA time zones with an explicit DST policy. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, data flow and boundaries
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test file and coverage
